blocks.prompt: 4 Find the equation of an ellipse centered at \((5, 3)\) that is tangent to both the x-axis and y-axis.
blocks.explanation:
Centre diya gaya hai, humein sirf dono semi-axes (aadhi axes) chahiye.
Kitab ke saare ellipses ki tarah yahan bhi ellipse ki axes coordinate axes ke parallel maani jati hain.
'Tangent to the axis' ka matlab hai ke ellipse us axis ko sirf ek point par chhoota hai, kaat'ta nahi.
Yahi shart har semi-axis ki lambai tay kar degi; intuition (andaza): centre se axis tak ka faasla hi semi-axis hoga.
steps:
Diya gaya: centre \((5, 3)\); ellipse x-axis aur y-axis dono ko chhoota hai.
Maloom karna: equation.
Tareeqa: \(\frac{(x-5)^2}{A^2} + \frac{(y-3)^2}{B^2} = 1\) likhein, jahan \(A\) horizontal aur \(B\) vertical semi-axis hai (abhi pata nahi kaun bara hai), phir chhoone ki shart lagayein.

y-axis ko chhoona (x = 0)
\[\frac{25}{A^2} + \frac{(y-3)^2}{B^2} = 1\]
\[(y-3)^2 = B^2\left(1 - \frac{25}{A^2}\right)\]
Sirf ek \(y\) ke liye \(1 - \frac{25}{A^2} = 0\), yani \(A^2 = 25\).
Kyun: agar \(A^2 > 25\) ho to right side positive, do \(y\) milenge aur axis ellipse ko kaategi; agar \(A^2 < 25\) ho to right side negative, koi \(y\) nahi. Sirf zero par ek point milta hai.

x-axis ko chhoona (y = 0)
\[(x-5)^2 = A^2\left(1 - \frac{9}{B^2}\right)\]
\[1 - \frac{9}{B^2} = 0 \Rightarrow B^2 = 9\]
Kyun: bilkul wohi daleel; ab y = 0 rakha.

Equation likhein
\[\frac{(x-5)^2}{25} + \frac{(y-3)^2}{9} = 1\]
Kyun: \(25 > 9\), is liye yeh horizontal ellipse hai, \(a = 5\), \(b = 3\).
Dhyan dein: \(a\) ko 3 aur \(b\) ko 5 mat samjhiye; centre ka x-coordinate 5 hai, jo y-axis tak ka faasla hai, aur woh horizontal semi-axis banta hai.

Ek nazar mein
Yeh sawal sochne ka hai, hisaab ka kam. Tasweer bana kar dekhiye: centre \((5, 3)\) se y-axis 5 units door hai aur x-axis 3 units. Ellipse dono axes ko sirf chhoota hai, is liye woh centre se har direction mein bilkul utna hi phaila hai jitna axis tak ka faasla hai. Calculation ne isi andaze ki tasdeeq ki.

Tasdeeq
Ellipse \(x = 5 - 5 = 0\) se \(10\) tak aur \(y = 3 - 3 = 0\) se \(6\) tak phaila hai. Yeh y-axis ko \((0, 3)\) par aur x-axis ko \((5, 0)\) par chhoota hai.
Kyun: har semi-axis centre se us axis tak ke faasle ke barabar hai jise ellipse chhoota hai, jaisa andaza tha.

blocks.text: Answer key Exercise 6.4 ke jawab 1 se 16 tak number karti hai, jab ke exercise mein 13 sawal hain. Is sawal ka jawab key 5 par chhapa hai. Key 4 (\(\frac{x^2}{36} + \frac{y^2}{20} = 1\)) sirf 1(iii) ka dohraya hua jawab hai; keys 4, 6, 7, 8 aur 12 kisi chhape hue sawal ki nahi.
